summary: Remote WebSocket server drives interactive PTY shell and self-upgrade on installer host
details: The agent connects to a configured WebSocket server (serverUrl, default ws://localhost:3456, overridable via environment to any remote host) and routes server-sent messages into privileged local actions. `terminal_input` messages are written directly into a spawned PTY (bash / powershell / pwsh / cmd) via `pty.write(msg.data)` in terminal.js, giving whoever controls the configured server a full interactive shell on the host running the agent. The same message router accepts server-issued file read/write/delete/move, git commit/push, `restart_agent`, and `upgrade_agent` (which invokes `npm install @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest` and restarts the service), so the remote party can additionally rotate the running code. Separately, at agent startup `ensureYeaftSkills` performs an unpinned `git clone` / `git pull --ff-only` of https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git into `~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/yeaft-skills-dev` and enables that plugin in `~/.claude/settings.json`, giving the same publisher a persistent, unversioned code-delivery channel into the installer's Claude plugin environment.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
